caseName: Louisville & Nashville Railroad v. United States
caseNameFull: LOUISVILLE & NASHVILLE RAILROAD COMPANY v. United States
syllabus: The obligation of a land-grant-aided railroad to transport at reduced rates “troops” of the United States applies, to the transportation of members of the Coast Guard when serving as. part of the Navy but not when serving under the Treasury.
summary: Judgment was rendered in favor of the United States in the court below. On plaintiff’s appeal the judgment was modified and affirmed and the case remanded, the Supreme Court deciding:

opinions.author: Beandeis
opinions.text:
Mr. Justice BeaNdeis

delivered the opinion of the Supreme Court April 10, 1922.
